channel.title: Pier & Point · UCSF Bayfront Medical Building
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for UCSF Bayfront Medical Building (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Added · UCSF Bayfront Medical Building: The record had no address
item.description: The record had no address. The City's Enterprise Addressing System has an address point for 520 Illinois St (address ID 869728) inside this record's outline. Added as the record's address. Source: https://data.sf.gov/resource/3mea-di5p.json?eas_address_id=869728.

item.title: Correction · UCSF Bayfront Medical Building: Long 'At a glance' values were cut to the fact itself…
item.description: Long 'At a glance' values were cut to the fact itself (or 'Sources differ'); the disputes, quoted excerpts and hedging moved to this record's open questions, with every source still named. No change to the record's status or shape. Source: Pier & Point's own text edit.

item.title: Correction · UCSF Bayfront Medical Building: The Bayfront Medical Building's opening was shown as…
item.description: The Bayfront Medical Building's opening was shown as August 27, 2024. The only article that could be read was published the day before and gives that day as the scheduled first day for patients, so the opening is now shown as August 2024 and the open questions list the sources that could not be read. Source: Hospital Management, "UCSF launches Mission Bay healthcare building", August 26, 2024 (https://www.hospitalmanagement.net/news/ucsf-launches-mission-bay-building/).
item.source: Hospital Management, "UCSF launches Mission Bay healthcare building", August 26, 2024 (https://www.hospitalmanagement.net/news/ucsf-launches-mission-bay-building/)

item.title: Correction · UCSF Bayfront Medical Building: The building's size is now given as 181,000 sq ft as…
item.description: The building's size is now given as 181,000 sq ft as built (the 182,800 sq ft in a 2021 article was the planned figure). UCSF Health says it celebrated its opening on Friday, August 23, 2024; Hospital Management had reported August 27 as the first day for patients, and no source read after that day confirms it. Source: Healthcare Facilities Today, 2024-08-29; UCSF Health, 2024-08-23 (sfch.ucsfhealth.org/node/1071); Hospital Management, 2024-08-26.
item.source: Healthcare Facilities Today, 2024-08-29; UCSF Health, 2024-08-23 (sfch.ucsfhealth.org/node/1071); Hospital Management, 2024-08-26

item.title: Correction · UCSF Bayfront Medical Building: The Bayfront Medical Building page no longer states…
item.description: The Bayfront Medical Building page no longer states one floor area, because sources give 181,000 to 190,000 sq ft; it lists them instead. It describes Clark as leading the construction team rather than as general contractor, cites post-opening articles for the August 2024 opening, and drops an unsourced total-cost figure. Source: https://sfyimby.com/2021/10/construction-starts-for-ucsf-clinical-building-at-block-34-mission-bay-san-francisco.html; https://healthcarefacilitiestoday.com/posts/UCSF-Health-Opens-Bayfront-Medical-Building--29713; https://www.stantec.com/en/news/2024/stantec-designed-ucsf-bayfront-medical-building-opens-mission-bay-campus; https://www.clarkconstruction.com/our-work/projects/ucsf-bayfront-medical-building-mission-bay; https://www.gb-eng.com/projects/detail/578; https://ophthalmology.ucsf.edu/directions-wgvcv/; https://data.sf.gov/resource/i98e-djp9.json?permit_number=M1227947.

item.title: Correction · UCSF Bayfront Medical Building: The construction start now reads September 2021, from…
item.description: The construction start now reads September 2021, from Clark's September 23, 2021 groundbreaking release, instead of October 2, 2021, which is only the date of SF YIMBY's article. The $228 million figure no longer says it covers the building alone: Commercial Property Executive does not say whether it includes the garage. The May 2020 Regents milestone now says the committee's agenda lists the Block 34 items for action, since the outcome was not shown by a source read, and cites the agenda. The record now separates the building's address (520 Illinois St, per CPE) from the Block 34 corner of 3rd and Mariposa and no longer quotes a UCSF project name that no readable source gives. Address, size, story count, architect, contractor and opening date are cited to CPE, SF YIMBY and Clark because UCSF Real Estate's page could not be read. The Wikimedia photo credit no longer names a flight the file page does not state. Source: Clark Construction, 2021-09-23 (https://www.clarkconstruction.com/news/clark-breaks-ground-ucsfs-new-clinical-building-mission-bay); Commercial Property Executive, 2024 (https://www.commercialsearch.com/news/ucsf-opens-228m-health-care-facility/); UC Regents Finance and Capital Strategies Committee agenda, 2020-05-19 (https://regents.universityofcalifornia.edu/regmeet/may20/fin-5.19.pdf); SF YIMBY, 2021-10 (https://sfyimby.com/2021/10/construction-starts-for-ucsf-clinical-building-at-block-34-mission-bay-san-francisco.html).

item.title: Added · UCSF Bayfront Medical Building: Commercial Property Executive's coverage of the building's…
item.description: Commercial Property Executive's coverage of the building's opening says 'the project's development costs amounted to $228 million'. The article does not say whether the figure includes the adjoining Illinois Street Garage. Source: https://www.commercialsearch.com/news/ucsf-opens-228m-health-care-facility/.

item.title: Complete · UCSF Bayfront Medical Building: UCSF Health Bayfront Medical Building opens… (~Aug 2024)
item.description: UCSF Health Bayfront Medical Building opens to patients in August 2024. Hospital Management's article of August 26, 2024, written the day before, says the building is "due to start receiving patients on 27 August" (a scheduled date, not a confirmed one). Healthcare Facilities Today (August 29, 2024) writes "UCSF is celebrating the opening of the UCSF Health Bayfront Medical Building", and Stantec's release (September 17, 2024) writes "Recently, the UCSF Bayfront Medical Building opened its doors"; neither gives the opening day, so only the month is shown (~Aug 2024). Source: Hospital Management (hospitalmanagement.net), 2024-08-26; Healthcare Facilities Today, 2024-08-29; Stantec, 2024-09-17.
item.source: Hospital Management (hospitalmanagement.net), 2024-08-26; Healthcare Facilities Today, 2024-08-29; Stantec, 2024-09-17

item.title: Milestone · UCSF Bayfront Medical Building: Construction of the Block 34 clinical… (~Sep 2021)
item.description: Construction of the Block 34 clinical building begins: Clark announces on September 23, 2021 that it has broken ground (SF YIMBY reported on October 2, 2021 that crews had started) (~Sep 2021). Source: Clark Construction Group (general contractor's own press release), 2021-09-23; San Francisco YIMBY, 2021-10.
item.source: Clark Construction Group (general contractor's own press release), 2021-09-23; San Francisco YIMBY, 2021-10

item.title: Milestone · UCSF Bayfront Medical Building: UC Regents' Finance and Capital Strategies… (~May 2020)
item.description: UC Regents' Finance and Capital Strategies Committee's May 19, 2020 open-session agenda lists for action preliminary-plans and working-drawings funding and scope for the Block 34 parking garage and preliminary-plans funding for the Block 34 clinical building; the outcome is not shown by a source read (~May 2020). Source: Regents of the University of California, 2020-05-19.
item.source: Regents of the University of California, 2020-05-19
